newsitem.title: FRANCE: Delors favours partial France Telecom sale.
newsitem.headline: Delors favours partial France Telecom sale.

text.p: French Socialist and former European Commission President Jacques Delors said he favoured opening up the capital of France Telecom and privatising Air France, French media reported on Monday.

Delors was quoted as telling Europe 1 radio that he was "favourable to opening up the capital" of France Telecom so that this "magnificent group, one of the five biggest in the world ...can forge all types of alliances".
In a reference to Air France, he said staff would understand the nature of competition only if the company were privatised.

Delors said he was encouraged by Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's remarks about consolidating the defence industry at a European level. But he said privatisation of the armaments industry was not necessary because all countries subsidise that sector.

The previous government was preparing to sell a minority stake in France Telecom and privatise state-controlled defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF, but the deals have been put on hold since the election of a Socialist-led government this month.
